parsed.rationale_overall: Both systems cover similar ground (529, tech reduction, retirement max-out, international/bond diversification) with comparable personalization and risk alignment, but System B provides more concrete, executable specifics (dollar amounts tied to portfolio size, specific tickers like BSV/VGSH, explicit match math) and introduces a duration-matched education reserve that better addresses the dual-timeline problem. System A's international rec relies on speculative underweighting of VXUS and less precise dollar figures, giving B a slight edge in factual grounding and actionability.
